quarterly_data.quarter: LS Eco Energy press release: release board (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook: LS-VINA's MV cable exports to the US are expected to grow more than 20% over last year; building on extra-high-voltage cable supply records in Europe and Singapore, LS Eco Energy recently obtained US certification for 230kV-class cable and is pursuing the US extra-high-voltage market. The company says US MV cable demand is rising fast as AI data-center and renewable investment expands, and that LSCUS is more than doubling its local production capacity. CEO Lee Sang-ho: the company is expanding exports to North America through affiliate synergy.
quarterly_data.figure: US MV cable exports expected +20% or more year on year; 230kV US certification obtained

connects_to.relationship: LS-VINA produces MV power cable for Gaon Cable's US subsidiary LSCUS

contracts.source: LS Eco Energy press release: release board (09-15-2026)
contracts.signal: LS Eco Energy supplied MV underground cable to a US solar farm: Gaon Cable's US subsidiary LSCUS signed the contract with the local customer and LS Eco Energy's Vietnam subsidiary LS-VINA manufactured the cable, which collects power inside the solar farm and carries it to the substation. LS Eco Energy plans to keep expanding distribution-cable supply to new US power-infrastructure projects through the cooperation with Gaon Cable.
contracts.units: MV underground cable; US solar farm
